exposure: lansoprazole exposure during the first trimester
cohort: The study included 106 pregnant women exposed to lansoprazole during the first trimester and 1788 control individuals exposed to non-teratogenic drugs, whose data was sourced from two Japanese facilities providing counseling on drug use during pregnancy between 1988 and 2017.
finding: Lansoprazole exposure during the first trimester is not associated with an increased risk of major malformations, stillbirth, miscarriage, or differences in birth weight.
